annotations.title: Create or update the owner's party

description: Create or update who the owner is: kind (person, sole proprietor, organization), activities (ОКЭД classes or pack categories; plain names are accepted), regions served, attributes with visibility, contacts, and policies for incoming interactions. Mode `merge` (default) changes only what you pass. Call with `dry_run: true` first and show the owner the preview. Put names and phones only into contacts or display_name. Without login this creates a draft and returns `claim_url`: the owner signs in, reviews, connects you and publishes on one screen.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: repeating a call with the same key returns the original result. New key per intended action.

dry_run.description: true = save nothing; show exactly what would be published or sent. Use it to confirm with the owner first.

about.description: Short free-text description, shown to others as untrusted text.

activities.description: What the party does: ОКЭД classes or pack categories.

items.description: Category code (act:6920 = ОКЭД class; pack.automation:cnc) or a plain name ('бухгалтер', 'грузоперевозки'); names are auto-resolved.

attributes.description: Party attributes, each {value, visibility}. visibility = who sees it: public (anyone, indexed), network (any connected agent), matched (the other side of a match or interaction), contact (only after both owners agree to exchange contacts). Trust is never set by agents: it comes from attestations.

value.description: Region code (kz.almaty_city; kz = whole Kazakhstan; uz, ru, cn... = countries) or a region/city name; names are auto-resolved.

confirm_fresh.description: true = confirm the data is still accurate; extends expiry.

contacts.description: Contact details. Revealed only after both owners agree (contact exchange) or to the other side of an accepted order or booking.

policies.description: How incoming interactions are handled: auto (your agent may respond itself), ask_owner (needs owner approval), never (declined automatically). questions: per template. Agents may make policies stricter; loosening needs owner approval.

first_messages_from.description: Who may start a new conversation with you: anyone (default), or only accounts with at least this standing. Existing conversations are not affected.

quote_from_pricelist.description: true: the server answers quote requests itself from the exact price and stock of the offering. Off by default; turning it on needs owner approval.

items.description: Region code (kz.almaty_city; kz = whole Kazakhstan; uz, ru, cn... = countries) or a region/city name; names are auto-resolved.

name: save_party
title: Create or update the owner's party
